en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an elegant interior salon scene. A well‑dressed man in a suit stands beside a round tea table, speaking with a seated woman in a long formal gown who holds a teacup. The room is richly furnished with a carpet, upholstered chair, footstool, decorative screen, framed pictures on the wall, and a tea service on the table. Printed French caption and series information appear at the bottom, while handwritten messages in blue ink run along the top and bottom margins.
